confirmedIssues.title: An initial paused request is presented as an empty Redis snapshot
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Without data or error, deriveDataState returns initial and isRefreshBlocked=true for fetchStatus=paused. TanStack pending+paused is not isLoading. Page ignores initial/isRefreshBlocked, sees no rows and isLoading=false, and selects empty. The detail panel then asserts Redis has no snapshot even though no request succeeded.
syntheticReproduction: Use a valid selected synthetic vehicle.
Supply query data=undefined, error=null, isError=false, isLoading=false, isFetching=false, isPending=true, fetchStatus=paused.
Trace page status: no vehicle=false; fatalError=false; rows=0; isLoading=false; stale=false => empty.
Expected: paused/offline initial-source guidance without claiming authoritatively empty Redis. Source-selected actual body is the Redis empty message.
confirmedIssues.narrowFixNeed: Page-only trust discrimination must use initial/isRefreshBlocked before empty, with localized paused guidance in its existing source adapter. Preserve retained rows and retained-empty behavior; no hook policy rewrite.

confirmedIssues.title: Vehicle-list loading or failure can strand the page in no-vehicle guidance
confirmedIssues.mechanism: useSelectedVehicle consumes only fleet query data and returns vehicles=[] when undefined, without loading/error/retry metadata. With no valid URL/store ID, effectiveId=null. Page treats this exactly like an empty fleet, disables snapshot refresh, and renders selection guidance with no fleet-source retry. A failed GET /vehicles is not a known empty fleet.
syntheticReproduction: Start without a selected URL/store vehicle.
Keep useVehicles data undefined while loading, then return isError=true with data still undefined.
Trace hook result: vehicleId=null and vehicles=[] in both states.
Expected: fleet loading then recoverable fleet error; source output remains Select vehicle with empty options, snapshot refresh disabled, and no fleet retry.
confirmedIssues.narrowFixNeed: Expose/consume fleet trust through an explicitly owned hook/page integration, or observe the existing fleet query on this page. Keep canonical selected-vehicle ownership; distinguish fleet loading/failure from genuinely empty fleet.

confirmedIssues.title: Mobile snapshot rows lose all per-signal trust metadata
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Caller allows only name/value on mobile. DataTable applies hidden md:table-cell to kind/source/timestamp. No mobilePresentation, expandable, renderExpanded or row-detail contract is supplied; hidden metadata cells therefore have no row-level mobile disclosure. Aggregate source counts cannot identify which visible reading is stale or unknown.
syntheticReproduction: Use a mixed fresh/stale/unknown synthetic snapshot.
At a viewport below 768px, inspect declared classes: all kind/source/last-update cells are hidden.
Attempt row detail: caller declares none, so there is no path to those original row fields.
Expected: every row's kind/source/freshness remains reachable through existing typed mobile summary/detail support.
confirmedIssues.reproductionExecution: NOTRUN; CSS/source behavior is proven, rendered/native geometry is not
confirmedIssues.narrowFixNeed: LiveSignalsTable-only adoption of existing DataTable mobilePresentation/detail or complete-field contained-scroll behavior; retain five fields, stable keys, sorting, filters and pagination. Do not patch shared DataTable to guess a domain detail.

confirmedIssues.title: Unknown zero timestamps become a concrete year-1 Last update
confirmedIssues.mechanism: For a zero Go time.Time, backend emits timestamp and ts as 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z, omits age_ms, and reports l2/unknown freshness. Adapter preserves that nonempty string. Table chooses TimeStamp because it is truthy; TimeStamp only rejects null/unparseable values, so the valid year-1 sentinel is formatted as a concrete old date, not unknown.
syntheticReproduction: Use envelope {value:0, source:l2, timestamp:0001-01-01T00:00:00Z, ts:0001-01-01T00:00:00Z} with age_ms absent.
rowFromEntry preserves timestamp; timestamp renderer takes TimeStamp branch.
Expected: unknown Last update with no fabricated age/date. Source chain instead renders a valid year-1 date and tooltip.
confirmedIssues.narrowFixNeed: Normalize the existing unknown-time sentinel in the inspector row adapter or explicitly owned wire-contract boundary without replacing zero values or losing valid timestamps. Cover unknown timestamps and existing legacy-source behavior.

confirmedIssues.title: Fresh Redis reads are described as verified in-process L1 provenance
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Distributed GetAll merges L1 and L2 and returns fresh Redis-only values. Handler explicitly lacks per-signal source and maps every recent nonzero timestamp to l1. UI then labels the count Fresh in-process and badge tooltip Read from the in-process SignalStore. Backend l1 means fresh/L1-equivalent here, not proof that the read was satisfied from L1.
syntheticReproduction: Source scenario: local L1 has no field; L2 returns a field timestamped within two minutes.
Distributed GetAll returns the L2 field; classifyLiveSource returns l1 solely from timestamp.
Page computes live count and renders Fresh in-process/L1 tooltip.
Expected: age-confirmed freshness without invented storage provenance, unless backend explicitly supplies actual per-field layer.
confirmedIssues.reproductionExecution: NOTRUN; no actual cache topology or live vehicle inspected
confirmedIssues.narrowFixNeed: One explicit frontend/API provenance agreement decision: retain freshness classification but accurately describe L1-equivalent/actual-layer unknown, or expose real source at an owned backend boundary. No page-local inference from polling/SSE health.
